verdict.rationale: Brex's marketing describes an "AI-powered expense assistant" and AI-powered automation of invoice entry and GL coding inside the product. These imply some in-product AI suggestions, but there is no explicit evidence of AI-generated insights or analysis of a user's spend data. HN commenters reacting to Brex's published ChatGPT examples raise accuracy concerns, including one apparently wrong receipt answer. That example isn't clearly the in-product feature, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. The MCP server serves external assistants and is not credited as in-product insight. Missing for 10: an explicit in-product insights/recommendations feature on spend data, docs describing what the expense assistant suggests, and independent hands-on corroboration of in-product AI quality.
